simplelib.title: SimpleLib
text.autoconfig.simplelib.option.legenda:
Fanfare and particles when a player finishes
one of the hardest advancements or makes a
legendary enchantment at its maximum level.
Default: true.

Every advancement with the challenge frame
(also from other mods) counts as legendary.
Default: false.

No Vanilla challenge jingle on the toast of
a legendary advancement - the legendary
choir plays instead. Client side.
Default: true.

Advancement ids added to the built-in list,
e.g. minecraft:story/enter_the_end.

Enchantment ids added to the tag
#simplelib:legendary, e.g. minecraft:mending.
commands.simplelib.config.save_failed: %s was changed to %s but the file could not be saved (see log).
commands.simplelib.config.help: %1$s [list [group] | get <option> | set <option> <value> | reset <option>]: shows and changes every option of this mod; Tab completes options and values.
jei.simplelib.note.upgrade.strikes: %s strikes, material in the off hand
text.autoconfig.simplelib.option.hangWat:
When the server tick stands still (also while
saving on quit), a list of all threads is
written to logs/simplebuilding-hang-*.txt.
Only reads, never changes the game.
Default: true.

How long the tick may stand before the dump
is written (10 to 600). A paused singleplayer
game does not count.
Default: 30.
text.autoconfig.simplelib.option.freeLoo:
Camera turns back: the view eases back to
where you look. Player turns to camera: you
now look where the camera looked.
A server can enforce its own choice.
Default: Camera turns back.
Crosshair Follows Aim While Free Look (this client)

Moves the normal crosshair to where you
actually aim (the direction of your body)
while Free Look is on; it is not drawn in the
screen centre then. Off: it stays centred.
Default: true.
Mouse Wheel Zooms While Free Look (this client)

While Free Look is on, the mouse wheel zooms
in and out (the hotbar does not scroll). When
Free Look ends, the zoom is back to normal.
Default: true.

The server's choice; it only counts for
players while "Enforce on Clients" is on.
Default: Camera turns back.

On: every player uses the server's choice
above; the client setting is ignored.
Sent when a player joins.
Default: false.

text.autoconfig.simplelib.option.guideOp: Guide Opens the Mod's Chapter (this client)

A Simple Modpack guide that came from an
old mod handbook opens at the first page of
that mod's chapter. Off: it opens at the
start page. Crafted guides always open at
the start page.
Default: false.
text.autoconfig.simplelib.option.slotAle: Red Beam on Triggering Items (this client)

A slow red glow breathes behind an
item in its slot (inventory and hotbar) while that item is causing an
effect on you (e.g. Collapsed blocks: Slowness).
Default: true.

Instead of the turning beam the slot glows still
and breathes slowly (no motion).
Default: false.

Instead of the soft pulse a red beam turns slowly
behind the item, like a lighthouse.
Default: false.

simplelib.guide.page.1.title: SimpleLib
simplelib.guide.page.1: What every Simple mod shares: this guide, warm food, shared materials, rarity tiers and Free Look.
simplelib.guide.page.2.title: Simple Modpack guide
simplelib.guide.page.2: One guide for every Simple mod, there with any of them installed: craft it from a book and a crafting table (shapeless), or get it from the first FTB Quests quest.
simplelib.guide.page.3.title: Simple Modpack guide
simplelib.guide.page.3: Bookmarks along the top pick a super-mod (SimpleBuilding, Simple Quality of Life, Simple Aesthetics ...; a sub-mod alone gets its own), bookmarks at the sides its chapters, one per mod.
simplelib.guide.page.4.title: Simple Modpack guide
simplelib.guide.page.4: A chapter opens with its advancement - mostly when you first pick up the item it names; until then its bookmark is grey and says what opens it. In creative mode every chapter is open.
simplelib.guide.page.5.title: Warm food
simplelib.guide.page.5: Cooked food comes out of a crucible warm and is eaten 15% faster while warm.
simplelib.guide.page.6.title: Shared materials
simplelib.guide.page.6: Base materials several Simple mods use: diamond pebble, cracked diamond and its block, netherite nugget,
simplelib.guide.page.7.title: Shared materials
simplelib.guide.page.7: the basic upgrade template, polished end stone (shared building block of the family) and the six building cores.
simplelib.guide.page.8.title: Shared materials
simplelib.guide.page.9.title: Cursed and Mythic rarity
simplelib.guide.page.9: Two tiers above Epic for every Simple mod: Cursed (radiant red name with a black shadow;
simplelib.guide.page.10.title: Cursed and Mythic rarity
simplelib.guide.page.10: in the tooltip the letters burn, orange and gold flames rise into them and run through the name) and Mythic (an opal of aquamarine, azure and lavender moving through the letters with a pearl gloss, a white sheen sweeping
simplelib.guide.page.11.title: Cursed and Mythic rarity
simplelib.guide.page.11: across in the tooltip, enchantment glint).
simplelib.guide.page.12.title: Legendary moments
simplelib.guide.page.12: The hardest advancements and the hardest enchantments play a deep choir and a particle show at the player.
simplelib.guide.page.13.title: Hang watchdog
simplelib.guide.page.13: When the server tick stands still, Simple Lib writes a list of all threads to the logs folder, so a frozen game can be diagnosed.
simplelib.guide.page.14.title: Free Look
simplelib.guide.page.14: While Free Look is on, the mouse turns only the camera, not the player; walking and all other input stay normal.
simplelib.guide.page.15.title: Free Look
simplelib.guide.page.15: Two keys: "Free Look (hold)" (standard left Alt) and "Toggle Free Look" (unbound, set it in the controls).
simplelib.guide.page.16.title: Free Look
simplelib.guide.page.16: When it ends, the camera turns back to where you look (standard) or you turn to where the camera looked - freeLookRelease in config/simplelib-client.json or the Free Look tab of the SimpleLib settings.
simplelib.guide.page.17.title: Free Look
simplelib.guide.page.17: A server can enforce its own choice (freeLookRelease + freeLookEnforce in simplelib-server.json, sent on join). Free Look is always off after joining, a world change and a respawn.
simplelib.guide.page.18.title: Commands
simplelib.guide.page.18: /simplelib config shows and changes every option of config/simplelib-server.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values). Values are bounded like in the file, saved at once and take effect at once;
simplelib.guide.page.19.title: Commands
simplelib.guide.page.19: options read only at start say so. Permission level 2. /simpleclient simplelib (list, get, set, reset, help) does the same for config/simplelib-client.json on your own client.
